19 open-source Google Nest projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Google Nest thermostats, cameras and speakers. 11 of 19 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: NoLongerEvil Thermostat, homebridge-nest, ha-google-home, ha-nest-protect, GHLocalApi.
